bundle.shortDescription: Learn reinforcement learning by training Rocket League bots.
bundle.longDescription: RL Studio trains a neural network to play Rocket League inside a headless physics simulation and shows you what it is learning: live training curves, a 3D view of the bot playing itself, a reward editor you can adjust mid-run, and an assistant that reads your metrics.
